country_data.use: server exclusion; client routing uses INCY geoip:ru

exclusion_basis: mandatory actual HTTPS egress IP against RU CIDRs; public Russian entry IPs and RU labels permitted
routing_policy: local direct; RU direct; everything else proxy
pool_selection: fresh checks only; two-site HTTPS HEAD health and latency; current performance bands; strict infrastructure caps; up to 40 nodes; client leastPing

quality_selection.warning: HTTPS latency checks do not measure sustained transfer speed or device/operator reachability.

ip_reputation.selection_priority: exclude listed exits; retain unlisted and unknown coverage; maximize count and infrastructure diversity
ip_reputation.meaning: No listing in this feed is not a positive whitelist or proof of Gemini access.

transport_checks.policy: TLS chain/name/expiry via system CA plus Xray HTTPS; REALITY via Xray; SS without TLS not applicable

latency_selection.policy: current quality bands first, exact median HTTPS latency within band; client leastPing unchanged
latency_selection.failed_probe_policy: current two-site HTTPS health required independently of extra HEAD measurements

client_geoip: geoip:ru from client installed geoip.dat; update client geodata

automatic_selection.group_score: live HTTPing through the fastest observed member
